assets.name: iron-wall
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE opaque seamless wall MATERIAL texture tile for HoloCrawl, logical32x32 pixels. Reference scene is style only. Material like an old thick iron security door: blue-gray cold steel plate, subtly brushed coarse pixel grain, sparse dull brown rust chips, a few shallow dents, restrained silver-gray highlights. NO doorknob, no door silhouette, no thick rim, no top concrete strip, no front/back composition, no repeating horizontal stripe, no black grout grid, no pipes, no bolts, no object, no scenery, no text or glow. Flat orthographic seamless edge-to-edge steel surface, 16 muted colors, coarse hard pixels without blur or antialias. Mid gray value, sufficiently lighter than dark dungeon floor, industrial not sci-fi spaceship. It will be used as material inside the game's existing connected corner/edge wall renderer, so surface only. Native32x32 scale.
